rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that represents or refers to something else rather than being literal.

example.english: This gift is very symbolic; it represents our friendship.
example.traditional: 呢份禮物好有象徵性，代表我哋份友誼。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan2 lai5 mat6 hou2 jau5 zoeng6 zing1 sing3 doi6 biu2 ngo5 dei6 fan2 jau5 ji4

rows.note: Use this for something relating to symbols as a system or form, especially in technical or academic contexts.

example.english: In mathematics, symbolic language is used to express abstract concepts.
example.traditional: 喺數學入面，符號性語言係用嚟表達抽象概念嘅。
example.jyutping: hai2 sou3 hok6 jap6 min6 fu4 hou2 sing3 jyu5 jin4 hai6 jung6 lei4 biu2 daat6 cau1 zoeng6 koi3 nim6 ge3
